description: This source file implements the CheckAudioUnderflow class, which checks for audio stream underflow conditions in a media playback pipeline. It queries the current position of the audio stream, compares it with the last sample timestamp, and triggers an underflow handling task if certain conditions are met.

classes.name: CheckAudioUnderflow
classes.description: A class responsible for checking audio underflow conditions during media playback.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the check for audio underflow by querying the current position and state of the pipeline, and triggers an underflow handling task if an underflow is detected.
